newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean army deserter surrenders.
newsitem.headline: South Korean army deserter surrenders.

text.p: A South Korean army deserter who opened fire and wounded nine soliders on Sunday has surrendered, a defence ministry spokesman said.
Kim Hee-yong, armed with a rifle and dozens of rounds of ammunition, deserted from his barracks near the border with North Korea on Sunday.
"He surrendered today after his mother and sisters persuaded him to do so," the spokesman said on Monday. "He is under interrogation."
The spokesman said four of nine soliders who were shot were still in a military hospital, but said they were not in grave condition.
